prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.6%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 69.6%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.4%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Split Layout Friend Selection: Redesign the pick_friend screen into a split view with live pet trait previews alongside choice cards. (why: Adoption has a high drop-off rate with only 69.6% conversion and a median completion time of 89s.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Pet Desktop Controls Walkthrough Screen: Add a dedicated tutorial screen right after home_intro explaining how to interact, move, and hide the desktop pet. (why: Support receives multiple emails from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after setup.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Account Sync Flow: Move sign-in step to occur right after pet adoption certificate so created pet data is immediately linked. (why: The #1 support theme (8 emails) is pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
3: [home, new_flow] Desktop Display Recovery Flow: Add interactive display troubleshooting and tip carousel to the waiting screen if rendering takes longer than expected. (why: Support emails note pets fail to display on desktop and mean home waiting time is over 38 minutes.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Account Preservation Sign-In Hint: Display a prominent hint on the sign_in screen clarifying that account creation saves and restores pet progress. (why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset upon signing in again.)
5: [choose_path, copy] Path Selection Value Proposition Copy: Update the headline and body of choose_path to explain quick pre-made pet adoption versus custom photo creation clearly. (why: Path selection takes a high mean time of 514s and has a 76.2% conversion rate.)
6: [adoption, layout] Stage Layout Photo Upload Guidelines: Switch upload_photos screen to stage layout with clear photo quality sample picker components. (why: 3 support emails report custom pet creation failures or poor quality output.)
7: [home, wait_info] Desktop Generation Time Estimate Info: Enable time estimates and status badges on the waiting screen while building desktop pet graphics. (why: The waiting step has a long mean completion time (2336s) and 81.3% conversion.)
8: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Mascot Celebration: Add an animated celebratory pet mascot and official badge on the adoption certificate screen. (why: Adoption step drops conversion down to 69.6%, reducing overall onboarding completion.)
9: [finish, notification] Desktop Pet Readiness Notification Toggle: Enable desktop readiness notifications and supportive guidance on the home_intro screen. (why: Finish step conversion drops to 64.8% with users uncertain if the pet has launched.)
